name: No-IP Free Dynamic DNS
free_limit: 1 free Dynamic DNS hostname on a No-IP-owned domain, 1 update client and a choice of 30 No-IP domains; no credit card required.
watch_out: Must reconfirm hostname every 30 days or it may expire/be deleted; no included SSL certificate, custom-domain DNS or paid Public Tunnels. Free tier is marketed for home users; commercial-use eligibility requires provider confirmation.
